pointerOpening: A secondary click on an otherwise unowned canvas-background point prevented the native menu and opened the creation menu at the client point.

A primary pointer down outside the non-modal content dismissed it. Escape also dismissed it.
filterAndKeyboard: Opening focused and selected the sticky Filter input.
Entering Text Input reduced the live grouped list to the one matching command.
ArrowDown moved the active option into the list and painted the setta-700 dark highlight.

creation.result: One new meta-control section appeared at the invocation workspace coordinate; the menu closed and focus returned to the document body in frozen main.

selectionMenu.sourceTrigger: NodesSelection.tsx prevents the native menu on .react-flow__nodesselection-rect and records the active node ids plus client x/y.
selectionMenu.mixedLockRule: SelectionContextMenu.tsx labels the action Unlock Position & Size only when every selected section is locked; an unlocked or mixed selection labels it Lock Position & Size and writes the common locked target.
selectionMenu.dismissal: Every structural action closes the menu and clears nodesSelectionDims; outside pointer down also closes through the shared core.
selectionMenu.liveCaptureLimitation: The browser bridge's modified drag events did not produce the ShiftLeft keydown lifecycle required by frozen main's shortcut engine, so it could not create the otherwise pointer-reachable selection rectangle. The evidence intentionally contains no fabricated selection-menu screenshot.
